dedupe_keys.name: lfgcost web landfill gas energy cost model

description: LFGcost-Web is an Excel model from the US Environmental Protection Agency Landfill Methane Outreach Program for initial economic assessment of landfill-gas energy projects. Users enter landfill characteristics and project assumptions. The model calculates gas-generation profiles, project size, installed capital and annual costs, internal rate of return, net present value and time to breakeven. It also estimates methane destruction and avoided carbon dioxide emissions. Eleven project types cover direct use, renewable natural gas, compressed natural gas, electricity and combined heat and power. Optional state-level employment and economic outputs apply to selected project types. The current provider page identifies version 3.6, released in September 2023, and Excel 2007 through Office 365 requirements. The public download has no stated charge; a reuse licence was not established. Defaults represent typical landfill projects and require local checking. This project-level screening model supports waste-energy capacity planning, with timing determined by the project inputs. LandGEM is a related gas-generation model. The workbook and bundled manual were not downloaded or executed.
